Word Formation

DEVELOP

Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word DEVELOP.

  1. Personal __________ is very important.
  2. I would like to become a __________ in the IT field.
  3. Germany is a __________ country.
  4. There are many __________ countries in Africa.
  5. This illness __________ because of the bad habit of smoking.
  6. His social skills are completely __________.
View Answers
  1. development
  2. developer
  3. developed
  4. developing
  5. developed
  6. undeveloped

EMPLOY

Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word EMPLOY.

  1. The company wants to __________ more people.
  2. She is __________ by a small company.
  3. The company has 50 __________.
  4. He is __________ at the moment.
  5. __________ is a serious problem in some countries.
  6. My __________ is very friendly.
View Answers
  1. employ
  2. employed
  3. employees
  4. unemployed
  5. unemployment
  6. employer

HELP

Complete each sentence with the correct form of the word HELP.

  1. Without Wi-Fi, he became completely __________.
  2. My dog watched me __________ while I was looking for my keys.
  3. This guide was very __________.
  4. His comment was totally __________.
  5. She __________ explained how to solve the problem.
View Answers
  1. helpless
  2. helplessly
  3. helpful
  4. unhelpful
  5. helpfully
